data.description:
# Let's get this Mixed Reality party started 🎉🎉

- **Single player** or **local multiplayer** for up to 4 players
- Real MR using your whole room with **your body as the controller**
- No motion sickness!
‎{1290463558797181}


# Mixed Reality
Scooping up slippery fish using your hands is natural and magical. Without controllers in the way everything feels virtually real so that even non-gamers can play. Seeing where you're going makes chasing around floating balloon bunnies comfortable and exciting.
{1401523864418127}‎


# Play Single Player
Uncover hidden strategies to beat your personal best, such as mastering the combo system or tossing fish basketball style


# Play Together
The real magic happens when you invite over friends and family (with some extra headsets) for a wholesome, chaotic party. All minigames can be played competitively or as a team cooperatively.
{1310998346926070}


# Setup
1. Accept permissions
2. Perform Scene Setup
3. Everyone use same Wi-Fi
4. Start the game one at a time to auto-connect together. When everyone's wearing different hat you're ready
5. Everyone push down the Play button with your hand to start

Remote online multiplayer isn't supported as everyone's room has a different layout and furniture


# Support
Troubleshooting Guide: https://www.fantailgames.com/troubleshooting

Contact: support@fantailgames.com

Join the community: https://discord.com/invite/mDWR7yjXy4


# Play on Quest 3/3S/Pro/2

changelog.change_log:
Holiday Update

We've added 4 new festival hats for the month of December

Translations for: German, French, Spanish, Korean, Swedish, Italian, Japanese, Chinese, Polish, Portuguese, and Turkish
Thank you so much to our community for help proof reading!

Otherwise we've been focused on fixing issues reported by our community on Discord (thank you and keep it coming):
> Implemented new hand tracking solution from Meta
> Added support button to dialogs for when things go wrong.
> 1 fish per player in fishing tutorial
> Added check to ensure both players are on the same version
> Added Discord button so you can join the community (note, you may need to search about a bit for where the window was spawned)

Let’s get the party rockin’ with some major updates!

> 44% smoother Physics!
> The game can now be launched multiplayer from the same primary account across multiple devices (app sharing must be turned off). This means less copies need to be purchased!
> Balloon Bunnies now wibbly and wobblier
> Fixed hang on load when rejoining a game
> Improved messaging when outside room or controllers are breaking hand tracking
> Numerous other small bug fixes and improvements

Spotted something we missed, let us know over on discord:
https://discord.com/invite/mDWR7yjXy4
We've fixed an issue loading the game without Hand Tracking enabled (which is required).

Official Early Access Release

Invite everyone you know with a Quest over and have the ultimate Game Night!

Featuring three minigames:
> Bouncing
> Fishing
> Slapping

Hop on over to our discord if you have any issues or ideas for new minigames. This is just the beginning!
Let's get the party started with the Game Night early access. Try out our first three minigames: Bouncing, Fishing and Slapping.
